name: lore
description: Local fine-tuning for your own tasks, except the one doing the training is you. A provider-neutral kit that turns scattered project criteria into distilled, invariant Lore — and operates it with eight skills: use-lore, brainstorming-lore, create-area, create-project, create-bot, save-to-lore, transmute-lore, obsidian-lore.
